name: There Does Not Exist
description: Negated existential quantifier — 'there does not exist'

name: Empty Set
description: Null/empty — often denotes vacuum or absent quantity

name: Element Of
description: Set membership — element of a set

name: Not An Element Of
description: Negated set membership — not an element of

name: Contains As Member
description: Reverse set membership — set contains element

name: Subset Of
description: Proper subset — all elements of A are in B, A ≠ B

name: Superset Of
description: Proper superset — B contains all elements of A, B ≠ A

name: Subset Of Or Equal To
description: Subset or equal — A is a subset of B (may be equal)

name: Superset Of Or Equal To
description: Superset or equal — B contains or equals A

name: Union
description: Set union — elements in A or B

name: Intersection
description: Set intersection — elements in both A and B

name: Set Minus
description: Set difference — elements in A but not in B

name: Plus-Minus Sign
description: Plus or minus — indicates two possible values

name: Infinity
description: Infinity — used in limits and improper integrals

name: Left Floor
description: Floor function — greatest integer less than or equal

name: Tilde Operator
description: Tilde — often used to denote AC voltage in schematics

name: Equivalent To
description: Equivalent to — often for asymptotic equivalence

name: Double Vertical Line
description: Norm or magnitude of a vector

name: Left Angle Bracket
description: Left angle bracket — bra vector or inner product

name: Right Angle Bracket
description: Right angle bracket — ket vector or inner product

name: Divides
description: Divides — a ∣ b means a divides b

name: Greek Small Letter Delta
description: Infinitesimal change — δ in ε-δ limit definition

name: Greek Small Letter Epsilon
description: Arbitrarily small positive quantity — ε in ε-δ definitions

name: Greek Small Letter Final Sigma
description: Greek small letter final sigma (word-final form)

name: Greek Small Letter Phi
description: Phase angle between voltage and current

name: Script Small L
description: Script l — often used for length or angular momentum quantum number

name: H Bar (Reduced Planck Constant)
description: Reduced Planck constant ħ = h/2π (alternative glyph)

name: Speed of Light
description: Speed of light in vacuum c = 299,792,458 m/s

name: Acceleration of Gravity
description: Standard acceleration due to gravity g ≈ 9.81 m/s²

name: Angstrom
description: Angstrom — 10⁻¹⁰ m, used for atomic/crystal distances

name: Degree Sign
description: Degree symbol — arc measure or temperature unit

name: Ohm Sign
description: Unit of electrical resistance — Ohm (separate from Greek Omega)

name: Upwards Arrow (Gas)
description: Gas evolution in a chemical reaction

name: pH (Acidity)
description: Measure of acidity/alkalinity — negative log of H⁺ concentration

name: Enthalpy Change
description: Change in enthalpy of a chemical reaction

name: Gibbs Free Energy
description: Change in Gibbs free energy — determines reaction spontaneity

name: Imaginary Unit (j)
description: Imaginary unit — used in EE instead of i (i = current)

name: Mole
description: Base unit of amount of substance

name: Tesla
description: Unit of magnetic flux density — Wb/m²

name: Gray
description: Unit of absorbed radiation dose — J/kg

name: Sievert
description: Unit of equivalent radiation dose — J/kg

name: Provable (Turnstile)
description: Syntactic consequence — provable in a system

name: Because
description: Because — introduces a reason or premise

name: Exclusive Or (XOR Symbol)
description: Exclusive OR — one or the other, not both (logic-specific glyph)

name: Left Curly Bracket
description: Opening curly brace — code block or object delimiter

name: Left Square Bracket
description: Opening square bracket — array index or list

name: Left Parenthesis
description: Opening parenthesis — function call or grouping

name: Less-Than Sign
description: Less-than sign — comparison or template/generic bracket

name: Greater-Than Sign
description: Greater-than sign — comparison or template/generic bracket

name: Ampersand
description: Ampersand — bitwise AND, address-of, or reference operator

name: Vertical Bar
description: Vertical bar — bitwise OR or pipe operator

name: Number Sign
description: Number sign / hash — preprocessor directive or comment

name: Commercial At
description: At sign — decorator/annotation in many languages

name: Dollar Sign
description: Dollar sign — variable prefix in PHP/shell/template literals

name: Percent Sign
description: Percent sign — modulo operator or format specifier

name: Exclamation Mark
description: Exclamation mark — logical NOT or assertion

name: Colon
description: Colon — key-value separator, type annotation, or label

name: Low Line (Underscore)
description: Underscore — identifier separator, placeholder, or unused binding

name: Reverse Solidus (Backslash)
description: Backslash — escape character or Windows path separator

name: Grave Accent (Backtick)
description: Backtick — template literal (JS) or command substitution (shell)

name: Apostrophe (Single Quote)
description: Single quote — character or string literal in many languages

name: Leftwards Arrow With Hook
description: Arrow with left hook — carriage return symbol

name: Left Right Double Arrow
description: If and only if / biconditional arrow

name: Long Rightwards Arrow
description: Long rightwards arrow — used in limits and reactions

name: Cent Sign
description: Cent — 1/100 of a dollar or euro

name: Pound Sign
description: Pound sterling — currency of the United Kingdom

name: Superscript Latin Small Letter N
description: Superscript letter n — common exponent variable

name: Chi Squared
description: Chi-squared statistic for goodness-of-fit and independence tests

name: Variance
description: Variance of a random variable Var(X) = E[(X-μ)²]

name: R Squared (Coefficient of Determination)
description: Coefficient of determination — proportion of variance explained

name: Null Hypothesis
description: Null hypothesis in statistical testing — H₀

name: Alternative Hypothesis
description: Alternative hypothesis in statistical testing — H₁

name: Black Circle
description: Black/filled circle — often used for points

name: Circle With Upper Right Quadrant Black
description: Circle with upper right quadrant filled

name: Partial Derivative
description: Partial derivative operator for multivariable functions

name: Limit
description: Limit — value a function approaches as variable tends to a point

name: Big O Notation
description: Big O — asymptotic upper bound (Landau notation)

name: Euler's Number
description: Euler's number — base of natural logarithm (≈ 2.718281828)

name: Imaginary Unit
description: Imaginary unit — i² = −1, basis of complex numbers

name: Derivative Notation (d/dx)
description: Derivative with respect to x — Leibniz notation

name: Partial Derivative Notation
description: Partial derivative with respect to x

description: First derivative in Lagrange prime notation f'

name: Second Derivative (Double Prime)
description: Second derivative in Lagrange notation f''

name: Pluto
description: Astronomical symbol for dwarf planet Pluto

name: Black Sun With Rays
description: Sun with rays — indicates clear/sunny conditions

name: Check Mark
description: Check mark — correct, done, or verified

name: Ballot X
description: X mark — incorrect, fail, or no

name: Ballot Box With X
description: Checkbox with X — cancelled or rejected

name: Music Flat Sign
description: Flat — lowers pitch by one semitone

name: Music Sharp Sign
description: Sharp — raises pitch by one semitone

name: Per Mille Sign
description: Per mille — per thousand, 1/10 of a percent
